svg.title: A trie, plain and compressed
svg.desc: A tree of medicine names stored by their letters. Names sharing a beginning share a path from the top. Left: one node per letter, with long single-file chains. Right: the same names with each single-file chain merged into one node, branching only where names differ.
svg.text: Green: where a whole name ends.
Built by the script from the story's names.
